The Fortune 2 standard

Our clients come first. Because we expect more from our associates, you can expect more from us — on the sale or purchase of the most important property you’ll own.

An independently owned and operated brokerage based in London, Ontario — twelve advisors working residential resale, new construction, commercial and business sales.

No. 05 The founder

Engineered for the long view.

Jimmy Singh founded Fortune 2 Realty and leads it as Broker of Record. With 18 years in real estate and a background in mechanical engineering and business administration, he brings an engineer’s precision to residential, commercial and business sales.
